description:
## Why This Exists

store/group_cache.rs::GroupMetadataCache::insert() calls Instant::now() in the eviction check (line 74) and then again when creating the CacheEntry (line 91). Between these two calls, some time passes. The entry's inserted_at reflects a later time than the eviction check's 'now', which means TTL measurements are slightly off: the entry appears to have been inserted after the eviction check's reference point.

Also, the eviction check captures 'let now = Instant::now()' and 'let ttl = self.ttl' but the inserted CacheEntry uses a fresh Instant::now(), not the same 'now' captured above.

## Acceptance Criteria

Capture a single Instant::now() at the start of insert() and use it for both the eviction comparison and the CacheEntry inserted_at field.
title: GroupMetadataCache::insert: Instant::now() called twice — inconsistent insertion time
